title: Not accurate
body: I installed the app and deleted it 10 minutes later. To get a feel for it, I scanned a few things I had that is certified GF. Both items flagged FLOUR. One item had no flour at all (corn, purely) and is certified. The other is also certified, but being flagged with flour. OAT flour, but the kicker: IT IS CERTIFIED and is labeled as such on the packaging. I’ve deleted the app.
